H1100.root: from [[w:H1097]] and [[w:H3276]];(often in connection with [[w:H0376]], [[w:H0802]], [[w:H1121]], etc.)
H1100.strongs: without profit, worthlessness; by extension, destruction, wickedness
senses: A name like sa.tan (שָׂטָן "Satan" H7854) This name means worthless, base, wicked

H1101.root: a primitive root; (also denominatively from [[w:H1098]]) to fodder
H1101.strongs: to overflow (specifically with oil.); by implication, to mix; to fodder
H1101.kjv: anoint, confound, [idiom] fade, mingle, mix (self), give provender, temper

H1103.strongs: to pinch sycamore figs (a process necessary to ripen them)
senses: (Qal) to gather figs, tend sycamore trees

H1104.strongs: to make away with (specifically by swallowing); generally, to destroy
H1104.kjv: cover, destroy, devour, eat up, be at end, spend up, swallow down (up)
senses: to swallow down, swallow up, engulf, eat up

H1105.kjv: devouring, that which he hath swallowed up

H1106.strongs: Bela, the name of a place, also of an Edomite and of two Israelites
senses: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.21; son of: Benjamin (H1144); brother of: Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); father of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abihud (H0031), Abishua (H0050H) and Ahoah (H0265) Also named: bal.i (בַּלְעִי "Belaite" H1108) § Bela = "destruction"
a son of Ahaz, a Reubenite

H1107.root: or בַּלְעֲדֵי; constructive plural from [[w:H1077]] and [[w:H5703]], not till, i.e. (as preposition or adverb)

H1108.strongs: a Belaite (collectively) or descendants of Bela
senses: Someone descended from Bela who was a man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.21; son of: Benjamin (H1144); brother of: Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); father of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abihud (H0031), Abishua (H0050H) and Ahoah (H0265) Group of be.la (בֶּ֫לַע "Bela" H1106A) § Belaites = "swallowing" descendants of Bela

H1109.root: probably from [[w:H1077]] and [[w:H5971]]; not (of the) people, i.e. foreigner
H1109.strongs: Bilam, a Mesopotamian prophet; also a place in Palestine
senses: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.22.5; son of: Beor (H1160H) Also named: Balaam (Βαλαάμ "Balaam" G0903) § Balaam = "not of the people" the son of Beor, a man endowed with the gift of prophecy

A man of the Moabites living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.22.2; son of: Zippor (H6834) Also named: Balak (Βαλάκ "Balak" G0904) § Balak = "devastator" a king of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel

H1112.root: or בֵּלְאשַׁצַּרlemma בֵּלְאשַׁצּר missing vowel, corrected to בֵּלְאשַׁצַּר
senses: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Dan.5.1; son of: Nebuchadnezzar (H5019) Also named: be.le.shats.tsar (בֵּֽלְאשַׁצַּר, בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר "Belshazzar" H1113) § Belshazzar = "Bel protect the king" king of Babylon at the time of its fall; he to whom Daniel interpreted the writing on the wall

A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Dan.5.1; son of: Nebuchadnezzar (H5019) Aramaic of be.le.shats.tsar (בֵּֽלְאשַׁצַּר, בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר "Belshazzar" H1112) § Belshazzar = "Bel protect the king" king of Babylon at the time of its fall; he to whom Daniel interpreted the writing on the wall
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.2 § Bilshan = "in slander" an exile who returned with Zerubbabel

H1115.strongs: properly, a failure of, i.e. (used only as a negative particle, usually with a prepositional prefix) not, except, without, unless, besides, because not, until, etc.
H1115.kjv: because un(satiable), beside, but, [phrase] continual, except, from, lest, neither, no more, none, not, nothing, save, that no, without
senses: except (after an implied or expressed negation) with prep
so as not, in order not

H1116.root: from an unused root (meaning to be high)
senses: high place, ridge, height, bamah (technical name for cultic platform)
Bamah = "high place" a place in Palestine (of places of idolatrous worship) Another name of giv.on (גִּבְעוֹן "Gibeon" H1391)

H1118.root: probably from [[w:H4107]] with prepositional prefix; with pruning
senses: A man of the tribe of Asher living before Israel's Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.33; son of: Japhlet (H3310); brother of: Pasach (H6457) and Ashvath (H6220) § Bimhal = "in circumcision: in weakness (by mixture)" a descendant of Asher

H1120.root: plural of [[w:H1116]]; heights; or (fully) בָּמוֹת בַּעַל; from the same and [[w:H1168]]; heights of Baal
H1120.strongs: Bamoth or Bamoth-Baal, a place East of the Jordan
senses: § Bamoth = "high places" or "great high place" a town on the river Arnon in Moab

H1121.strongs: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H1121.kjv: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth

senses: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.15.18 § Ben = "son" a Levite, one of the porters appointed by David for the ark

H1123.strongs: {a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense}
senses: son, child Aramaic of ben (בֵּן ": child" H1121)
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.11; son of: Abinadab (H0041J); married to Taphath (H2955) § Ben-Abinadab = "son of Abinadab" an officer of Solomon

H1126.root: from [[w:H1121]] and [[w:H0205]]; son of my sorrow
H1126.strongs: Ben-Oni, the original name of Benjamin
senses: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.35.18; son of: Israel (H3478) and Rachel (H7354); brother of: Joseph (H3130); half-brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783); father of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Jamin at 1Sa.9.1,4; 22.7; 1x Another name of bin.ya.min (בִּנְיָמִין "Benjamin" H1144G) § Ben-oni = "son of my sorrow" the name given to Benjamin by Rachel
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.13; son Geber (H1398) § Ben-geber = "the son of Geber" or "the son of a man" an officer of Solomon

H1128.root: from [[w:H1121]] and a derivative of [[w:H1856]]; son of piercing (or of a lance)
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.9; son of: Deker (H1857) § Ben-dekar = "son of stabbing" or "son of Dekar" an officer of Solomon

H1129.kjv: (begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), [idiom] surely
senses: to build, rebuild, establish, cause to continue
to build a house (ie, establish a family)
to be built up (of childless wife becoming the mother of a family through the children of a concubine) Aramaic equivalent: be.nah (בְּנָה "to build" H1124)

H1130.strongs: Ben-Hadad, the name of several Syrian kings
senses: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.15.18; son of: Tabrimmon (H2886) § Ben-hadad = "son of Hadad"
the king of Syria, contemporary with Asa of Judah
the son of Hazael, also king of Syria
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.10; also called Binnui at Neh.7.15; Another spelling of ba.ni (בָּנִי "Bani" H1137Q) § Binnui = "built up"
an exile returnee with Zerubbabel, son of Henadad, who assisted at the reparation of the wall of Jerusalem, under Nehemiah
a Levite in time of Ezra, father of Noadiah
another Levite in time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife
still another Levite in time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife

A man of the tribe of Judah(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.20; son of: Ishi (H3469H); brother of: Zoheth (H2105) § Ben-zoheth = "son of Zoheth" one of the tribe of Judah

A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.8; son of: Hur (H1133H) § Ben-hur = "son of whiteness" or "son of Chur" a man who was commissariat officer for Solomon in Mount Ephraim
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ch.17.7 § Ben-hail = "son of strength" or "son (man) of might" a ruler (prince) under Jehoshaphat

A man of the tribe of Judah(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.20; son of: Shimon (H7889); brother of: Amnon (H0550H), Rinnah (H7441) and Tilon (H8436) § Ben-hanan = "son of favour" one of the tribe of Judah

H1137.strongs: Bani, the name of five Israelites
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Sa.23.36 § Bani = "built"
a Gadite, one of David's mighty warriors
a Levite of the line of Merari, and forefather to Ethan
a man of Judah of the line of Pharez
"children of Bani" returned from captivity with Zerubbabel
one or up to three Levites in Nehemiah's time
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.9.4 § Bunni = "built"
a Levite in the time of Nehemiah

H1139.root: from the plural construction of [[w:H1121]] and [[w:H1300]]
H1139.strongs: sons of lightning, Bene-berak, a place in Palestine
senses: § Bene-barak = "sons of lightning" a city in Dan

H1141.root: or בּנָיָהוּ; (prolonged) from [[w:H1129]] and [[w:H3050]]; Jah has built
H1141.strongs: Benajah, the name of twelve Israelites
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.8.18; son of: Jehoiada (H3077); father of: Ammizabad (H5990) § Benaiah = "Jehovah has built" or "Yahweh has built up"

one of David's mighty warriors, son of Jehoiada the chief priest, a Levite, set by David over his bodyguard, later having remained faithful to Solomon during Adonijah's attempt on the crown, was raised into the place of Joab as commander-in-chief of the army
the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite, one of David's thirty mighty warriors, and the captain of the eleventh monthly course
a Simeonite, a prince of the families of Simeon
a Levite in the time of David who played with a psaltery on Alamoth
a priest in the time of David, appointed to blow the trumpet before the ark
a Levite of the sons of Asaph
a Levite in the time of Hezekiah
Four Israelites in the time of Ezra who had taken strange wives

H1142.root: from the plural of [[w:H1121]] and [[w:H3292]]; sons of Yaakan
H1142.strongs: Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert
senses: § Bene-jaakan = "sons of twisting" an Israelite place of encampment in the wilderness (same as be.e.rot be.ne-ya.a.qan (בְּאֵרֹת בְּנֵי־יַעֲקָן "Beeroth-bene-jaakan" H0885))

H1143.strongs: a double interval, i.e. the space between two armies
senses: man of the space between armies, i.e. champion (of Goliath) (meton)

H1144.root: from [[w:H1121]] and [[w:H3225]]; son of (the) right hand
H1144.strongs: Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
senses: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.35.18; son of: Israel (H3478) and Rachel (H7354); brother of: Joseph (H3130); half-brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783); father of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Jamin at 1Sa.9.1,4; 22.7; 1x § Benjamin = "son of the right hand"
Jacob's and Rachel's youngest son, Joseph's full brother
son of Bilhan, great-grandson of Benjamin
a Benjamite, one of the sons of Harim, in the time of Ezra who had taken a strange wife
the tribe descended from Benjamin, the son of Jacob

H1145.root: sometimes (with the article inserted) בֵּן־הַיּמִינִי; with [[w:H0376]] inserted (1 Samuel 9:1) בֶּן־אִישׁ ימִינִי; son of a man of Jemini; or shortened אִישׁ יְמִינִי; (1 Samuel 9:4; Esther 2:5) a man of Jemini, or (1 Samuel 20:1) simply יְמִינִיxlit Yᵉmînîy corrected to Yᵉmîynîy
H1145.strongs: a Benjaminite, or descendent of Benjamin
senses: Someone from the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.35.18; son of: Israel (H3478) and Rachel (H7354); brother of: Joseph (H3130); half-brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783); father of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Jamin at 1Sa.9.1,4; 22.7; 1x Group of bin.ya.min (בִּנְיָמִין "Benjamin" H1144) § Benjamite = "a son of the right hand" one of the tribe of Benjamin
a building, structure Aramaic of bin.yan (בִּנְיָן "building" H1146)

H1148.root: probably from [[w:H1121]] with pron. suff.; our son
senses: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.10.13 § Beninu = "our son" a returning Levite exile who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah

A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.8.37; son of: Moza (H4162H); father of: Raphah (H7498), Eleasah (H0501H) and Azel (H0682A) § Binea or Bineah = fountain a descendant of Jonathan

H1151.root: from [[w:H1121]] and [[w:H5971]] with pronomial suffix; son of my people
senses: A man of Ammon living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.19.38; son of: Lot (H3876) and his second daughter (H3876I); half-brother of Moab (H4124H) § Ben-ami = "son of my people" son of Lot, born to his second daughter, progenitor of the Ammonites

H1152.root: from [[w:H5475]] and [[w:H3050]] with prepositional prefix; in (the) counsel of Jehovah
senses: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.6; father of: Meshullam (H4918S) § Besodeiah = "with the counsel of Jehovah" or "in the secret of the Lord" father of one of the repairers of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.49 § Besai = "my treading" a temple slave (or group of slaves) who returned with Zerubbabel

H1154.root: from an unused root meaning to be sour
senses: unripe or sour grapes Another spelling of bo.ser (בֹּ֫סֶר "unripe grape" H1155)

H1156.kjv: ask, desire, make (petition), pray, request, seek
senses: to ask, seek, request, desire, pray, make petition

H1157.strongs: in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.
H1157.kjv: about, at by (means of), for, over, through, up (-on), within
senses: behind, through, round about, on behalf of, away from, about
on behalf of (metaph. especially with Hithpael)

H1158.strongs: to gush over, i.e. to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask
H1158.kjv: cause, inquire, seek up, swell out
senses: to seek out, swell, cause to swell, boil up, enquire
to be swelling, bulging, swelling out

H1160.root: from [[w:H1197]] (in the sense of burning); a lamp
H1160.strongs: Beor, the name of the father of an Edomitish king; also of that of Balaam
senses: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.32; father of: Bela (H1106) § Beor = "burning"
father of Bela, king of Edom

H1162.root: from an unused root of uncertain meaning
H1162.strongs: Boaz, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple
senses: A man of the tribe of Judah living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Rut.2.1; son of: Salmon (H8007) and Rahab (H7343); married to Ruth (H7327); father of: Obed (H5744) Also named: Booz (Βοόζ "Boaz" G1003) § Boaz = "fleetness"
ancestor of David, kinsman-redeemer to Ruth, daughter-in-law of Naomi
name of the left of two brazen pillars, 18 cubits high, erected in the porch of Solomon's temple

H1166.root: a primitive root; also as denominative from [[w:H1167]]
H1166.strongs: to be master; hence, to marry
H1166.kjv: have dominion (over), be husband, marry(-ried, [idiom] wife)
senses: This name means to be married Another name of ye.ru.sha.laim (יְרוּשָׁלִַ֫ם, יְרוּשְׁלֵם "Jerusalem" H3389)

H1167.strongs: a master; hence, a husband, or (figuratively) owner (often used with another noun in modifications of this latter sense)
H1167.kjv: [phrase] archer, [phrase] babbler, [phrase] bird, captain, chief man, [phrase] confederate, [phrase] have to do, [phrase] dreamer, those to whom it is due, [phrase] furious, those that are given to it, great, [phrase] hairy, he that hath it, have, [phrase] horseman, husband, lord, man, [phrase] married, master, person, [phrase] sworn, they of
senses: (noun of relationship used to characterise-ie, master of dreams)
§ Baal = "lord" esp. lord, specif. as divine name, Baal supreme male divinity of the Phoenicians or Canaanites
owner, lord Aramaic of ba.al (בַּעַל ": master" H1167)

H1170.strongs: Baal-Berith, a special deity of the Shechemites
senses: § Baal-berith = "lord of the covenant" a god of the Philistines

Baal-gad = "lord of fortune" a city noted for Baal-worship, located at the most northern or northwestern point to which Joshua's victories extended Another name of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount)Hermon" H2768)

H1173.strongs: Baalah, the name of three places in Palestine

H1174.root: from [[w:H1167]] and [[w:H1995]]; possessor of a multitude
senses: Baal-hamon = "lord (possessor) of abundance" the site of Solomon's vineyard Another spelling of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount)Hermon" H2768)

H1175.kjv: Bealoth, in Aloth (by mistake for a plural from [[w:H5927]] with prepositional prefix)
senses: Baalath or Bealoth = "mistresses" a town in south Judah Another name of ba.a.lat be.er (בַּעֲלַת בְּאֵר "Baalath-beer" H1192)

H1176.strongs: Baal-Zebub, a special deity of the Ekronites
senses: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.1.2 § Baal-zebub = "lord of the fly" a Philistine deity worshipped at Ekron

H1177.strongs: Baal-Chanan, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite
senses: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.38; son of: Achbor (H5907) § Baal-hanan = "Baal is gracious"
one of David's officers, a Gederite, who had the superintendence of his olive and sycamore plantations

H1178.root: from [[w:H1167]] and a modification of [[w:H2691]]; possessor of a village
senses: § Baal-hazor = "lord of the village" a town on the border between Ephraim and Benjamin, apparent location of a sheep farm of Absalom and location of Amnon's murder
Baal-hermon or Baal-chermon = "lord of destruction" a city near or on Mount Hermon, named as a seat of Baal worship Another name of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount)Hermon" H2768)

H1180.root: from [[w:H1167]] with pron. suff.; my master
H1180.strongs: Baali, a symbolical name for Jehovah
senses: Baali = "my lord" a deity in the northern kingdom, variation of the name 'Baal' Another name of ye.ho.vah (יהוה "LORD" H3068G)

A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.5.16; son of: David (H1732); brother of: Amnon (H0550), Chileab (H3609), Absalom (H0053), Adonijah (H0138), Shephatiah (H8203), Ithream (H3507), Shammua (H8051H), Shobab (H7727), Nathan (H5416), Solomon (H8010), Ibhar (H2984), Elishua (H0474), Nepheg (H5298H), Japhia (H3309I), Elishama (H0476H), Eliphelet (H0467), Tamar (H8559H), Elpelet (H0467I), Nogah (H5052) and Jerimoth (H3406N); also called Beeliada at 1Ch.14.7; Another name of el.ya.da (אֶלְיָדָע "Eliada" H0450G) § Beeliada = "the lord knows" a son of David, born in Jerusalem, elsewhere named 'Eliada'
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.5 § Bealiah = "Jehovah is master" a Benjamite who went over to David at Ziklag and was one of David's mighty warriors

H1184.root: from the plural of [[w:H1167]] and [[w:H3063]]; masters of Judah
senses: Baale-Judah = "the lords of Judah" a place in Judah named for the Baalim, also known as Kirjath-jearim, Kirjath-baal; modern Kuriet el Enab Combined with qir.yat ye.a.rim (קִרְיַת יְעָרִים "Kiriath-jearim" H7157)

H1185.root: probably from a derivative of [[w:H5965]] with prepositional prefix; in exultation
senses: A man of the Ammonites living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at Jer.40.14 § Baalis = "lord of the banner: in causing the joy" king of the Ammonites at the time of the destruction of Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar

H1186.strongs: Baal-Meon, a place East of the Jordan
senses: § Baal-meon = "lord of the habitation" a town in Reuben, mentioned in connection with Nebo, and in the time of Ezekiel, Moabite
Baal-peor = "lord of the gap" the deity worshipped at Peor with probable licentious rites Another name of ba.al (בַּעַל "Baal" H1168A)

H1188.root: from [[w:H1167]] and the plural of [[w:H6556]]; possessor of breaches
senses: § Baal-perazim = "lord of the breaks" the site of a victory of David over the Philistines, and of a great destruction of their images; also called 'Mount Perazim'

H1189.root: from [[w:H1168]] and [[w:H6828]] (in the sense of cold) (according to others an Egyptian form of Typhon, the destroyer); Baal of winter
senses: § Baal Tsphon or Baal-zephon = "lord of the north" a place in Egypt near the Red Sea where Pharaoh and his army were destroyed during the Exodus

H1190.strongs: Baal of Shalishah, Baal-Shalishah, a place in Palestine
senses: § Baal-shalisha = "thrice-great lord" a place in Ephraim near Gilgal

H1192.root: from [[w:H1172]] and [[w:H0875]]; mistress of a well
senses: § Baalath-beer = "mistress of the well" a town in the south part of Judah, given to Simeon, which also bore the name of 'Ramath-negeb'
§ Baal-tamar = "lord of the palms" a place near Gibeah in Benjamin

H1194.strongs: Beon, a place East of the Jordan
senses: Beon = "in the dwelling: indwelling" a place or city in Reuben Another name of ba.al me.on (בַּ֫עַל מְעוֹן "Baal-meon" H1186)

H1195.strongs: Banana, the name of four Israelite
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.12; son of: Ahilud (H0286); brother of: Jehoshaphat (H3092) § Baana or Baanah = "in the affliction"
the son of Ahilud, Solomon's commissariat officer in Jezreel and the north of the Jordan valley
father of Zadok who assisted in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah

H1196.root: from a derivative of [[w:H6031]] with prepositional prefix; in affliction
H1196.strongs: Baanah, the name of four Israelites
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.4.2; son of: Rimmon (H7417B); brother of: Rechab (H7394) § Baana or Baanah = "in affliction"
a Benjamite, son Rimmon, who with his brother Rechab murdered Ish-bosheth. For this, killed by David, mutilated bodies hung up over the pool at Hebron
a Netophathite, father of Heleb or Heled, one of David's mighty warriors
the head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel

H1197.root: a primitive root; also as denominative from [[w:H1198]]
H1197.strongs: to kindle, i.e. consume (by fire or by eating); to be(-come) brutish
H1197.kjv: be brutish, bring (put, take) away, burn, (cause to) eat (up), feed, heat, kindle, set (on fire), waste
senses: to burn, consume, kindle, be kindled
to begin to burn, be kindled, start burning

H1198.strongs: properly, foot (as consumed); i.e. (by exten.) of cattle brutishness; (concretely) stupid

senses: A womanof the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.8; married to Shaharaim (H7842) § Baara = "brutish" one of the wives of Shaharaim, a Benjamite
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.10; son of: Hesed (H2618) § Ben-hesed = "son of mercy" an officer of Solomon
ruin, heap of ruins Another spelling of i (עִי "ruin" H5856)

H1181.root: from the plural of [[w:H1168]] and the plural of [[w:H1116]]; Baals of (the) heights
H1181.strongs: Baale-Bamoth, a place East of the Jordan
senses: Baale-bamoth = "the lords of the high places" the people of Arnon, east of Jordan
